## Adr

* [ADR-001: The host owns the shell; apps provide UI modules](adr/ADR-001-host-owned-shell.md) - NooblyJS is one host process that mounts child apps (`/factory`, `/teammates`, `/knowledge`) next to its own areas (Home, Product Factory, Platform).

## Audits

* [Production readiness audit — all of NooblyJS (2026-10-12)](audits/2026-10-12-production-readiness-audit.md) - Verdict: ready for a supervised pilot on one machine, on loopback, with a small team that is told what is still simulated.
* [Security audit — all of NooblyJS (2026-10-12)](audits/2026-10-12-security-audit.md) - Verdict: not safe to run anywhere other people can reach it, until S-01 to S-03 are fixed.
* [Product: NooblyJS against Productboard and Aha! (2026-10-21)](audits/2026-10-21-product-tools-comparison.md) - Asked 2026-10-21: "look at … Productboard and Aha!
* [What is still mocked, simulated or static (audit, 2026-10-11; updated 2026-10-21, Phase 24)](audits/mocking-audit.md) - Found by reading the code of every repo and by starting NooblyJS on a blank data folder (`npm run seed:blank`) and looking at what each page still shows with nothing in the system.
* [Security review — Phase 13 (2026-10-11)](audits/phase-13-security-review.md) - What was checked before a pilot, what was fixed, and what remains.

## Runbooks

* [NooblyJS runbooks](runbooks/README.md) - What to do, step by step, when NooblyJS is running for a team.
* [Back up and restore](runbooks/backup-restore.md) - NooblyJS keeps everything in files under `DATA_DIR`.
* [A budget stopped the agents](runbooks/budget.md) - Every agent action is checked against its system's budget first (Platform · Settings · Budgets).
* [Start, stop and check NooblyJS](runbooks/start-stop.md) - NooblyJS is one Node process that hosts every app.
* [A sync that is stuck or wrong](runbooks/sync.md) - NooblyJS reads the Jira issues linked to work items and the pull requests the Software Factory opened every `DEVTOOLSSYNCMINUTES` (5).
* [A leaked or expired token](runbooks/tokens.md) - NooblyJS's credentials are environment variables (`.env`); none is in `data/`, a backup, the outbox or the audit log.
* [Writing to Jira and Bitbucket](runbooks/writes.md) - Jira and Bitbucket are production systems.
